title: Registration Deadline for Semester Fall 2026
summary: All students are required to complete their course registration by October 30th. Failure to register will result in late fees.
description: This is an official announcement from the administration of Ideal Commerce College regarding the Fall 2026 course registration process. Students must verify their course enrollment with their respective department advisors prior to submitting the online form.

title: Mid-Term Examination Schedule Released
summary: The comprehensive schedule for the upcoming Mid-Term examinations is now available for download. Please verify your exam routine.
description: The Mid-Term examination for HSC and Degree batches will commence from November 10th. All students must collect their admit cards from the admin block room 204 prior to the exams.

title: Merit Scholarship Applications for Fall 2026
summary: Applications are now open for academic merit scholarships. Eligible students can apply through the student portal.
description: Ideal Commerce College is offering up to 50% tuition fee waivers to high-performing students. Applicants must maintain a minimum GPA of 3.80 and submit their supporting documents by November 5th.

title: Revised Holiday List for Winter Session
summary: The administrative board has updated the holiday schedule for December. Please take note of the upcoming changes.
description: Ideal Commerce College will remain closed on December 16th in observance of Victory Day, followed by the scheduled winter vacation starting December 24th.

title: Inter-College Debate Competition 2026
summary: Registration is now open for the annual Inter-College Debate Competition. Showcase your eloquence and win prestigious awards.
description: The Ideal Commerce College Debating Club (ICCDC) is organizing the National Inter-College Debate Fest. Teams from all academic departments can sign up with their respective club captains.

title: Campus Wi-Fi Maintenance Schedule
summary: The IT department will be performing routine maintenance on the campus network this weekend. Brief outages are expected.
description: Network services including the ICC Student Portal and campus Wi-Fi access points will undergo routine maintenance from Saturday 10:00 PM to Sunday 4:00 AM.

title: Form Fill-up Notice for Final Exams
summary: Eligible students must fill out their examination forms online by the end of this month to avoid a late submission penalty.
description: Final exam form fill-ups are now active on the portal. Ensure all tuition fee clearances are processed before submitting the final routine form.

title: Annual Sports & Cultural Week Announcement
summary: Get ready for the annual sports week! Cricket, football, and indoor game signups begin next week at the sports office.
description: Ideal Commerce College presents the 2026 Sports & Cultural Week. Interested participants should contact their departmental sports representative.

title: Library Book Return and Renewal Reminder
summary: All borrowed books from the summer semester must be returned or renewed by October 5th to avoid daily late fines.
description: The Central Library requests all students and faculty members to clear outstanding book dues. Online renewals are enabled through the ICC Library Catalog portal.

title: Freshman Orientation Class 2026-2027
summary: Welcome newly admitted students! Orientation sessions will take place on October 2nd at the Main Auditorium.
description: All newly enrolled XI class and Undergraduate freshmen are invited to attend the orientation ceremony. Parents are welcome to attend. Attendance is mandatory for students.

title: Voluntary Blood Donation Camp
summary: The ICC Social Welfare Club is hosting a one-day blood donation drive in association with Red Crescent Society.
description: Join us in saving lives! The camp will run from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM at the College Gymnasium. Free health checkups and refreshments will be provided to all donors.

title: Second Semester Tuition Fee Payment Notice
summary: The last date for second-installment tuition fee payment without late fees is September 30, 2026.
description: Payments can be made via Nagad, bKash, or bank deposit at designated campus counter desks. Late fee of 500 BDT will apply after the deadline.

title: Special Workshop on Financial Modeling
summary: Department of Finance presents a 2-day hands-on workshop on Excel and Financial Modeling for business students.
description: Learn key skills in valuation, forecasting, and corporate finance. Certificates will be awarded upon completion. Limited seats available—register at Lab 3.

title: Updated Campus Transport Routes and Timings
summary: Please review the revised college bus schedules and pickup points starting next Monday.
description: Due to ongoing road construction on Route 4, college buses will divert through the North Express Highway. Revised departure times are updated in the schedule.

title: HSC Practical Examination Guidelines 2026
summary: Important instructions for all 2nd-year HSC candidates appearing in upcoming practical exams.
description: Students must bring signed lab notebooks, admit cards, and standard lab aprons. Practical exams start on September 20th across respective laboratories.

title: Career Fair & Corporate Networking Day
summary: Meet top employers and industry experts at the ICC Annual Career Fair on September 15.
description: Over 20 corporate firms, banks, and tech companies will be hiring for internships and entry-level positions. Bring 5 updated copies of your resume.

title: Student Identity Card Re-issuance Notice
summary: Students with damaged or lost ID cards must apply for replacement before the upcoming exam season.
description: Forms for duplicate smart ID cards are available at the Registrar's Office. A processing fee of 200 BDT applies along with a copy of the GD report for lost cards.

title: Annual National Science & Tech Expo 2026
summary: Call for projects! Submit your innovative science and business technology ideas for entry into the expo.
description: Ideal Commerce College invites team entries across three categories: Web & App Projects, Business Innovations, and Green Tech. Cash prizes worth BDT 1,000,000 up for grabs.

title: Canteen Quality & Price Control Committee Notice
summary: Revised food menu and fixed pricing list enforced across all campus cafeterias.
description: In response to student feedback, the college oversight committee has updated cafeteria price charts and strict hygiene standards. Feedback boxes are installed near canteen entrances.

title: Call for Articles: Annual College Magazine 'Pratibimb'
summary: Submit your original poems, short stories, essays, and artwork for the 2026 edition of our magazine.
description: All students and alumni can email their creative submissions to magazine@icc.edu.bd. Selected works will be printed in the December issue.

title: Need-Based Financial Aid Applications Open
summary: Financial support options available for students facing genuine economic hardship.
description: Submit income proof and guardian application letters to the Welfare Office. Applications are evaluated confidentially by the financial aid committee.

title: Faculty Evaluation Survey - Summer 2026
summary: Student course evaluation forms are live on the student portal. Feedback is completely anonymous.
description: Completing the faculty feedback survey is mandatory to view final course grades. Please submit your evaluations before August 10.

title: National Tree Plantation Drive 'Green Campus'
summary: Join the ICC Eco Club in planting 500 saplings around campus grounds this Thursday.
description: Volunteers will receive certificates of appreciation. Free saplings will also be distributed to participants to plant in their homes.

title: Notice Regarding Campus Security & Code of Conduct
summary: Wearing student ID cards visibly around campus is strictly mandatory at all entrance gates.
description: Security personnel have been instructed to deny access to individuals without valid ID badges or guest permits. Visitors must log details at Security Gate 1.

title: Supplementary / Improvement Exam Routine
summary: Schedule published for grade improvement and retake exams for previous semester courses.
description: Exams begin July 25th. Apply via portal and clear retake fees by July 18th to receive your exam admit slip.

title: Photography Club Exhibition & Contest 'Lenses 2026'
summary: Theme: 'Urban Life & Nature'. Submit high-resolution photos to participate.
description: Winning photos will be displayed in the Art Gallery and featured in the college annual calendar. Deadline for submissions is July 20.

title: English Language & Communication Workshop
summary: Enhance public speaking and professional writing skills with certified language trainers.
description: Free 4-week weekend workshop organized by the Department of English. Open to all current students of Ideal Commerce College.

title: Classroom Relocation Notice for Building B
summary: Due to renovation works, Room 301-305 classes are relocated to New Academic Block floor 2.
description: Changes take effect from Monday next week. Please check class schedules updated on the central departmental bulletin boards.

title: Alumni Networking Reunion Dinner 2026
summary: Inviting all former students of Ideal Commerce College to reconnect and network.
description: Registration is open online for the Grand Alumni Reunion scheduled for November 2026. Early bird registration ends July 31.

title: Pre-Monsoon Weather Advisory & Safety Notice
summary: Guidelines for campus activities during severe weather and heavy monsoon rainfall warnings.
description: In case of heavy weather advisories, emergency updates will be broadcasted live on the student portal and SMS notifications. Stay safe and avoid standing near open drains or waterlogged electrical posts.
